questions.subject: science
questions.context: A balloon is left in a hot car.
questions.question: State what happens to the balloon and explain why.

mark_points.text: Particles gain energy and move further apart

rejects: the balloon grows because it is hot

answers.text: The balloon expands because the particles gain energy and move further apart.

questions.subject: history
questions.context: Source Y: an invented notice listing new rules for a market.
questions.question: Study Source Y. What can you infer about the market? Explain your answer.

lorms.descriptor: Describes source without making an inference

lorms.award_rules: 2 marks for 1 inference unsupported; 3 marks for 2 inferences unsupported

answers.text: The market was disorderly. The notice lists many new rules, which suggests there were problems.
